title: Site Reliability Engineer
text:
About Lumen Grid
Lumen Grid forecasts demand for utilities moving to renewables. We are a small, remote-first engineering team that ships every day and keeps on-call quiet.
The role
As a Site Reliability Engineer you will own services end to end: design reviews, the code, the dashboards and the pager. You will work closely with product and with the other engineers on the team.
What you will need
- 3+ years of hands-on experience with Helm
- 4+ years of hands-on experience with Kubernetes
- 5+ years of hands-on experience with Kafka
- 2+ years of hands-on experience with gRPC
- several years of hands-on experience with Redis
- Clear written communication; we decide things in documents
Nice to have
- Exposure to Elasticsearch
- Exposure to Terraform
- Exposure to Distributed Systems
Benefits
Competitive salary and equity, a learning budget, and four weeks of vacation that people actually take.
